Let \(V=\mathbb F_\ell^r\), \(Q=\ell^r\), and let
\[
m=\frac n2=2q^2
\]
be the number of transpositions of \(\pi\).

For \(\sigma\) above \(\pi\), write
\[
\sigma(\alpha_i^{(j)})=\zeta^{a_i^{(j)}}\alpha_{\pi(i)}^{(j)},\qquad
\sigma(\rho_j)=\zeta^{s_j}\rho_j ,
\]
with every \(s_j\ne0\). For a transposition block \(T=\{i,\pi(i)\}\), put
\[
b_T^{(j)}=a_i^{(j)}+a_{\pi(i)}^{(j)},\qquad
y_T^{(j)}=\frac{b_T^{(j)}}{2s_j}.
\]
The product relation gives
\[
\sum_T y_T=\frac12\left(\frac{s_2}{s_1},\ldots,\frac{s_1}{s_r}\right)=\frac{c_s}{2}.
\]

For \(k\in V\), the number of \(2\)-cycles on \(\Omega_k\) is
\[
C_k=Q A_k,
\]
where
\[
A_k=m\mathbf 1_{k=0}+2N_k,
\]
and \(N_k\) is the number of ordered distinct pairs \((T,T')\) with
\[
y_{T'}-y_T=k.
\]

Thus the problem is equivalent to counting multisets \(\{y_T\}_{T=1}^m\subset V\) whose difference autocorrelation has the prescribed three-level form. The given differences force the Fourier magnitudes of the multiplicity function \(f(y)=\#\{T:y_T=y\}\) to be
\[
|\widehat f(\chi)|=
\begin{cases}
2q^2,&\chi=1,\\
q+4Q,&0\ne\chi\in U^\perp,\\
q+2Q,&\chi\in W^\perp\setminus U^\perp,\\
q,&\chi\notin W^\perp .
\end{cases}
\]
Using \(2q\equiv1\pmod Q\) and the primitivity of \(2\) modulo \(\ell\), the usual cyclotomic rigidity gives equality only for
\[
f
=
A\cdot 1_V
+q\,\delta_{c_s}
+2\ell^2\,1_{c_s+W}
+2\ell\,1_{c_s+U},
\]
with
\[
A=\frac{2q^2-q-4Q}{Q}.
\]
The sum condition indeed gives
\[
\sum_y yf(y)=q\,c_s=\frac{c_s}{2},
\]
since \(q\equiv 1/2\pmod\ell\). Hence for every admissible pair \((s,W\subset U)\) there is exactly one \(\widetilde C_\pi\)-conjugacy orbit.

So it remains only to count \(s\) and flags with
\[
\mathbf 1,c_s\in U\setminus W.
\]
The map
\[
s\mapsto c_s=\left(\frac{s_2}{s_1},\ldots,\frac{s_1}{s_r}\right)
\]
has image
\[
\{c\in(\mathbb F_\ell^\times)^r:\prod_i c_i=1\},
\]
and every \(c\) has exactly \(\ell-1\) preimages.

Let
\[
d=\gcd(r,\ell-1).
\]
There are \(d\) scalar vectors \(c=\lambda\mathbf 1\) with \(\prod c_i=1\). For such \(c\), the number of flags with \(\mathbf1\in U\setminus W\) is
\[
\ell^{r-2}\frac{\ell^{r-1}-1}{\ell-1}.
\]
For the remaining \((\ell-1)^{r-1}-d\) vectors, \(\mathbf1\) and \(c\) are independent, and the number of flags is
\[
\ell^{r-3}(\ell^{r-2}-1).
\]

Therefore the required number of conjugacy orbits is
\[
\boxed{
d\ell^{r-2}(\ell^{r-1}-1)
+(\ell-1)\bigl((\ell-1)^{r-1}-d\bigr)\ell^{r-3}(\ell^{r-2}-1)
}
\]
where \(d=\gcd(r,\ell-1)\).
